{{Quote|I'll start with the Skaak Tippers compound.|A spacer, to [[Hugo Eckener/Legends|Hugo Eckener]]|<ref name="SWG:RKE">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Rescue Karl Eckener|Naboo}}</ref>}}
The '''Skaak Tipper Compound''' was an underground facility located a short distance north of the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] in the [[Western Great Grass Plains]] on the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].

==History==
{{Quote|Good. Now one last thing, I think. Get me some weapon research notes from their researchers. I want to see what new toys the Skaak Tippers are developing.|[[Jorgellansel]]|<ref name="SWG:DDD">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Doing Darkwalker Deeds|Naboo}}</ref>}}
[[File:SkaakTipperCompound2.jpg|280px|thumb|The interior of the Skaak Tipper Compound.]]
During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], the criminal organization known as the [[Skaak Tippers]] used the compound as a base.<ref name="SWG:TtCotFMCG" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Mercious Bragg|Bragg]] and the [[RSF Intelligence Division]] investigated the Skaak Tipper Compound while searching for the responsibles of a [[Terrorist attack in Theed|terrorist attack]] in Theed.<ref name="SWG:TtCotFMCG">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Tap the Communications of the Four Major Criminal Groups|Naboo}}</ref> In the meantime, the compound was attacked by [[Darkwalkers|Darkwalker]] spacers led by [[Jorgellansel]].<ref name="SWG:DDD" /> Later, the wanted murderer [[Hunnos Jarkey]] briefly took refuge in the Skaak Tipper Compound after he escaped the Royal Naboo Security Forces.<ref name="SWG:CtEM">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Catch the Escaped Murderer|Naboo}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Skaak Tipper Compound was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TtCotFMCG" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Skaak Tipper Compound was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]]" with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
